scope: The complete fixed, non-promotable intact-NIXT conditional application study; scientific plan plus execution-contract-proposed.json are jointly authoritative. Approval is not original causal-event replication, profitable Alpha, implementation approval, resource admission, or order authorization.

findings.finding: Actual primary source, recent index rulebook and issuer implementation evidence reviewed. Nixed historical index results exclude investor costs and are sponsor research; Greenwood/Sammon short event-window decay is counterevidence to a liquidity-pressure story, not a direct test of five-year reversal. Synthetic cap-index plus quality filter differs from actual S&P deletions.

Unlevered recent absolute return and small-value matched increment are genuine investment questions. Issuer September2026 one-year market return26.23% and inception annualized16.06% support a bounded recent application check, not the whole-account tens-to100% objective. NIXT is selected for a published deletion/reversal mechanism and live implementation, not ETF convenience; avoid promoting size/value beta as deletion Alpha.
No artificial14-day historical wait. Existing postlaunch real fund history can answer application-use/defer now. Multi-year event mechanism cannot be refuted from this short live sample.

Five fixed application definitions and12diagnostic controls; all are reported, no winner selection. Historical/state depth, matched-information attribution and20k implementation/capital depth change economic information. Source33year aggregate tables remain separate and do not count as a newly reproduced data curve.

Source-fidelity limit stated. IWN/VBR/IWM and matched-host replacement are appropriate baselines. Paired block inference/MDE/shift placebo limit confidence; a circular alignment placebo is not causal deletion identification. PBO N/A for no selection is appropriate; DSR/SPA remain diagnostics, not promotion family evidence.

Joint execution contract resolves initial allocation then drift, fully funded integer shares, payable-date cash dividends, zero cash yield primary and separate BIL sensitivity. 20bps per actual ETF entry side and40bps stress are conservative modelling conventions; historical arrival ask/quotes required for exact-entry evidence. Four dates sample execution conditions, not fill capacity of every date. Internal index turnover/fees embedded in ETF observations, not investor daily rebalancing.
No trained ML/LLM/modality claim. OLS is attribution, fixed sizing is unoptimized and cash/no-orders is fallback. Missing quotes means exact executable entry N/A, not OHLC substitution.

Complete current conditional application outcome can be produced today within2CPU-core-hours/900MiB single-core fresh admission. No Hadan/cloud lane needed. The missing original event/PIT/GEIU data is an external limitation; do not build a generic reconstruction platform or pretend source-faithful study complete.

Common-date matrix, fixed20% replacement and identical-host IWN counterfactual are meaningful marginal tests. Host net10 convention remains net10 and its limitations must travel with every mixed result; this is not evidence of an executable consolidated20k host account without holdings/funding evidence. G3 unavailable is explicitly N/A.

Requested market reads are bounded12/10MiB/no retry with zero new spending. Source metadata does not yet constitute a performance result; subsequent implementation and actual comparison, not further gates alone, are the milestone.

Use/defer/not_at_depth decision and missing-input exit are defined. Every pre13October2026 observation stays diagnostic/seen. No OOS reset, leveraged target-chasing or paper launch from this approval; applicable separate promotion gates remain.
